briefdescription.para: Unit and integration tests for LegalLlmAdapter (Phase 2).

detaileddescription.para:
Test groups:
LegalLlmAdapterConfigTest : config getter/setter, hasModel/hasAdapter
LegalLlmAdapterPhase1Test : Phase 1 behaviour (no THEMIS_ENABLE_LLM needed)
LegalLlmAdapterJsonTest : JSON response parsing via nlohmann::json
LegalLlmAdapterPhase2Test : Phase 2 health-check & LLM wiring (compiled only when THEMIS_ENABLE_LLM=ON)
LegalLlmAdapterIntegTest : Integration test with a real GGUF model (GTEST_SKIP if no model is available)
